resources.string:
I-SandFly isifundi sesikrini sabantu noma izimo lapho kunzima ukubona isikrini. Inikeza impendulo ekhulunywayo ukuze ukwazi ukusebenzisa idivayisi ngaphandle kokubheka isikrini.

Uma i-SandFly ivuliwe, into egxilisiwe esikrinini ifundwa ngokuzwakalayo.

Swayiphela kwesokudla ukuze uye entweni elandelayo, nakwesokunxele ukuze uye entweni edlule.

Manje swayiphela kwesokudla ukuze uthole inkinobho ethi Okulandelayo.
